node.title: why the output is not my expected?
node.author: zhenyisong
node.doctext: use Modern::Perl; use autodie; sub find_chores { return (8,456,310); } my $value = find_chores(); say $value; I think the return value is the list contains 3 numbers, and when in the scalar context, the $value should be 3. However, the return value is the last element of the list. Even I used the conserved word 'scalar' before the function find_chores(), the returned value was still 310, not 3 as the expected. This is confusing me. Do I miss something here?
